jobs.title: Case Manager (Watt Ave. Interim Housing)
jobs.description:
**Position Overview**:  

Case Managers (CMs) provide housing\-focused case management and supportive services to individuals and families experiencing homelessness within a low\-threshold non\-congregate interim housing site. They meet clients where they are, supporting them in achieving goals and developing long\-term housing plans. CMs connect clients to essential resources, such as medical and mental health care, counseling, and permanent housing. Working in partnership with nonprofits, government entities, law enforcement, and healthcare providers, CMs ensure clients receive coordinated care to obtain and maintain permanent housing as quickly as possible.



**Work Environment and Work Schedule**:

This position is in\-person, onsite at our Watt Ave. Safe Stay Community Shelter. The role will be scheduled for one of the following shifts, 5 days a week:
* 7:00am\-3:30pm
* 8:00am\-4:30pm
* 9:00am\-5:30pm

  

**Key Responsibilities/Essential Functions**  

*Client Needs Assessment*



* Meet with clients over multiple interactions to help them prioritize and obtain the housing and supportive services available to them, with the patience and understanding that it takes an average of 8\-10 contact attempts before a client begins to trust the CM and voluntarily engage in case management services.



*Housing Placement*



* Help clients find and access housing programs
* Complete housing applications
* Create and execute a long\-term housing plan



*Linkage to Supportive Services*



* Screen clients for eligibility and provide referrals to appropriate services
* Find resources using 2\-1\-1 and other community resources approved by the team supervisor
* Complete a “warm handoff’ or other coordination assistance with partner agencies



*Advocacy*



* Call, email, provide verification of homelessness, or offer other communication to partner agencies to help clients access resources
* Offer to accompany clients to appointments if the client has difficulty navigating services or representing their needs
* Develop and maintain positive professional relationships with various stakeholders to help clients achieve their goals and maintain City Net’s positive reputation in the community.



*Data Collection*



* Thoroughly, accurately, consistently, and timely gather and document various types of data…
	+ To better understand client needs o To accurately assess client eligibility for community resources\-to share with funders and stakeholders to improve the county’s service landscape
	+ To enter into the Homeless Management Information System (HMIS) and the county’s Coordinated Entry System (CES)
* Follow all Coordinated Entry System protocols and organizational procedures



*Compliance and Goal\-Meeting*



* Consistently meet all assigned productivity and outcome goals
* In all activities, comply with all contracts, funder requirements, and City Net procedures and policies
* Meet or exceed all goals and requirements established for this position



**Qualifications**



* Upbeat passion for ending homelessness
* Must be eligible to drive a company vehicle to transport clients. For insurance purposes, drivers need to be at least 21 years old, must have a valid drivers’ license, and be approved to drive a City Net vehicle by our insurance company.
* Desire to make a difference in the lives of our most vulnerable neighbors during this time of uncertainty and beyond
* Empathetic, self\-motivated, flexible, dynamic
* Experience cultivating and maintaining productive, professional relationships with various stakeholders required
* Understanding of the importance of quality and timely data collection and reporting

* Ability to work well with people from diverse backgrounds with varying degrees of experience

jobs.description:
ROLE SUMMARY


As part of Pfizer Specialty Care, this individual will report to the Regional Director, Patient Access \& Reimbursement. The Access Care Manager (ACM) serves as a field\-based access leader responsible for integrating patient journey ownership, reimbursement expertise, and account\-level strategy to ensure appropriate patient access. This role combines high\-touch patient engagement with advanced subject matter expertise in reimbursement, payer policy, and coverage strategy, acting as a trusted partner to healthcare providers and internal stakeholders.

Patient Journey Leadership \& Case Management

* Serve as the primary point of contact for consented patients across the treatment journey from enrollment through therapy initiation and continuation.
* Conduct patient needs assessments addressing coverage, affordability, and logistical barriers to access for consented patients.
* Assist in coordinating care across healthcare providers, caregivers, and sites of care to ensure continuity and timely progression to therapy for consented patients.
* Maintain accountability for end\-to\-end patient progression, ensuring proactive identification and resolution of barriers.


Reimbursement Subject Matter Expertise

* Act as a field\-based expert on reimbursement, coverage pathways, and payer policy impacting Pfizer therapies.
* Provide guidance on the prior authorization process, step edits, coding, and payer\-specific requirements.
* Support the resolution of reimbursement challenges through appropriate escalation and coordination.


HCP Education \& Training

* Deliver compliant education on reimbursement processes, coverage pathways, and patient access resources, including .
* hub services, enrollment processes, and financial assistance programs to improve access efficiency.


Account\-Level Strategy \& System Optimization

* Develop and execute account\-level access strategies to improve patient access at scale.
* Identify systemic barriers and implement solutions to optimize workflows and assist in reducing delays in therapy initiation.


Payer Interaction \& Access Resolution

* Engage with payer organizations, as appropriate, to clarify coverage policies and support resolution of access challenges.
* Facilitate communication between HCP offices, payers, and patient support programs to ensure efficient navigation of the reimbursement process.


Internal Strategic Influence \& Market Insights

* Provide actionable insights on payer trends, reimbursement challenges, and access barriers to internal stakeholders.
* Support development of cross\-functional strategies by translating field insights into recommendations.
* High degree of Business Acumen and deep understanding of market dynamics and drivers in the Access space and accounts.


Cross\-Functional \& Commercial Alignment

* Collaborate with Sales, Key Account Managers, Marketing, and Patient Solutions teams to ensure aligned execution of access strategies.
* Participate in account planning and contribute to coordinated, patient\-centric approaches to access.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**


Candidate demonstrates a breadth of diverse leadership experiences and capabilities including: the ability to influence and collaborate with peers, develop and coach others, oversee and guide the work of other colleagues to achieve meaningful outcomes and create business impact.

* 8\+ years of pharmaceutical (or related) experience in customer\-facing roles/functions, 9 with Masters, BSN or Rph
* 1\+ years in Access and Reimbursement support role
* Minimum 3–5 years of Specialty Pharma experience, preferably within the Pharmaceutical/ Biopharmaceutical sectors, Provider/Carrier Networks, or Government Agency. Reimbursement and Access experience is a must and experience in the Cardiology sector is preferred. Strong understanding of Reimbursement, Government Payment Systems, Provider/Carrier Networks, Co\-Pay Assistance Programs, and knowledge of the Specialty policy dynamics that exist in the Rare Disease Community.
* Experience demonstrating exceptional communication and presentation skills, strategic planning and success in implementation of plans. This individual must also have demonstrated leadership and success at working across internal boundaries and be able to collaborate with multiple stakeholders to coordinate various unique objectives.
* Demonstrated ability to work in a highly regulated environment and adhere to strict company compliance guidelines and procedures. Proven track record of collaborating broadly with a diverse range of customers, clients, and stakeholders. Training in and experience in responsible business communication both written and spoken.
* Valid US driver’s license and driving record in compliance with company standards. Any DUI/DWI or other impaired driving citation within the past 7 years will disqualify you from being hired.

* Build trust through consistent, in\-person engagement
* Advocate for timely access to care, services, and resources

* Represent Pacific Health Group in the community through outreach events, partnerships, and local initiatives

**ABOUT US:**


United Way is advancing the common good in Ventura County by providing help today in ways that strengthen tomorrow. United Way has the scope, expertise and influences to bring together human services agencies, government, businesses, private foundations and dedicated volunteers around a common vision of creating maximum impact and achieving long\-lasting results. Why United Way? We all want to have the greatest possible impact on our community and the issues that we care about. Join the movement. At United Way, you unite your hopes and strengths with others to accomplish more than any of us can alone.


**ORGANIZATIONAL OVERVIEW:**

The mission of the United Way of Ventura County is: “To Mobilize and Inspire the Caring Power and Resources of our Community.” In keeping with this charge and in response to the shelter crisis in Ventura County, United Way of Ventura County launched a Homelessness Initiative to include a Landlord Engagement Program (LEP) to increase housing stock and utilize existing housing vouchers and housing subsidies provided by local jurisdictions and community partners in preventing and ending homelessness. Everyone needs a safe place to call home, yet that basic need is increasingly out of reach for many people in Ventura County. Limited affordable housing supply, extremely low vacancy rates, and prohibitive and rising rents, make home access for those with housing barriers exceedingly challenging. Advocating for these individuals and families includes recruiting, cultivating, retaining, and growing the number of landlords willing to help prevent and end homelessness.


**POSITION SUMMARY:**


The Housing Navigator position provides direct client support to assist individuals and families experiencing or at risk of homelessness. This role is responsible for conducting client intakes, determining program eligibility, collecting and verifying documentation, maintaining accurate case records, and connecting clients to housing and community resources. The position also assists with housing navigation activities, landlord engagement, outreach, lease\-up coordination, and ongoing housing retention efforts. Working closely with case managers, community partners, and property owners, this role helps ensure clients receive timely, coordinated, and person\-centered services while supporting the organization’s mission to promote housing stability and prevent homelessness. **Intake Duties:**

The TCC ensures that all discharge processes are completed accurately and efficiently, including verifying orders, resolving logistical challenges, and coordinating with the interdisciplinary team. This role also provides tailored education to patients and families on discharge instructions, medications, follow\-up care, and community resources. By addressing barriers such as incomplete orders, medication access, or transportation delays, the TCC ensures timely and safe discharges while empowering patients and families with the knowledge and resources needed to manage their health post\-discharge. The TCC operates independently, demonstrating initiative and adaptability in dynamic healthcare environments, improving patient outcomes, reducing readmissions, and enhancing satisfaction.

  


**Duties and Responsibilities:**

  


* **Patient Discharge Execution**


* Physically discharge patients by verifying that all orders are completed and ensuring the readiness of discharge medications and documentation.
* Collaborate with the bedside RN and Charge Nurse to help eliminate any identified barriers to a timely discharge.
* Coordinate with case managers, pharmacists, and nursing staff to address any last\-minute issues or barriers to discharge.
* Help resolve logistical challenges, such as arranging transportation or ensuring proper equipment is available for home use.

Founded in 1989, the Asian American Senior Citizens Service Center (AASCSC) is a nonprofit organization dedicated to improving the health and well\-being of culturally diverse and historically underserved communities throughout Orange County.

**Position Summary**

The ECM Bilingual Care Coordinator serves as a trusted partner for Medi\-Cal members by helping them navigate healthcare systems, community resources, and services that support their overall health and well\-being.

· Participate in ongoing training, quality improvement activities, documentation reviews, and professional development.

**Team Collaboration**

· Participate in individual supervision, case consultations, team meetings, and required trainings.

· Collaborate with colleagues across programs and community partners to provide coordinated, person\-centered services.

· Assist with member intake, referral outreach, temporary caseload coverage, community events, and other agency activities as needed.

**Minimum Qualifications**

**Required**

* Bilingual proficiency in English and Chinese (Mandarin and/or Cantonese), including verbal and written communication.

* Knowledge of Orange County community resources.
